$comment: Ars Technic AI Blueprint — node graph over the ArchiveRestorer engine (WIV is the internal canvas bundle name).

tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run --allow-net --allow-read --allow-env --allow-write=workflows,workspace server.ts
tasks.check: deno check core/*.ts core/cinema/*.ts gen/*.ts bridge/*.ts codegen/*.ts ui/*.ts tools/*.ts server.ts check_runtime.ts tests/*.ts
tasks.verify: deno task codegen --check && deno task check && deno task test

$fmtComment: gen/ and tokens.css are byte-compared against codegen output; formatting them would make `codegen --check` fail forever.
